articles.title: Binance adds 11 US-listed ETFs to wealth management offering
articles.summary: The crypto exchange is expanding its traditional finance offerings with 11 US-listed exchange-traded funds focused on US Treasurys and investment-grade bonds.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth could boost dollar dominance, US Treasury demand: BoE official
articles.summary: A Bank of England policy maker said digital dollars could expand access to the US currency while turning stablecoin issuers into bigger buyers of government debt.

articles.title: How a simple coding mistake let a hacker drain $7.8 million from a crypto wallet
articles.summary: Security firms traced the $7.8 million loss to a helper contract the wallet owner had authorized, not to Safe itself.

articles.title: Solana more than triples transaction size limit with mainnet upgrade
articles.summary: Solana raised its transaction size limit to 4,096 bytes, giving developers more room for zero-knowledge proofs and transactions with multiple signatures.

articles.title: Live updates: Senate faces high-stakes 60-vote hurdle on crypto's landmark Clarity Act
articles.summary: Senate crypto bill faces a do-or-die 60-vote test as partisan fights over presidential conflict rules and state AG powers leaves federal digital asset regulation hanging by a thread.

articles.title: CLARITY Act odds fall to 16% as key Democrats resist GOP’s ‘final’ offer
articles.summary: Banking groups also said the GOP’s final text leaves stablecoin reward loopholes, while tribal gaming interests warn that its prediction market provisions threaten tribal sovereignty.

articles.title: US seeks $61M in USDT allegedly tied to sanctioned Iranian oil sales
articles.summary: Tether froze $61.19 million across 10 Tron addresses in 2025 that prosecutors allege were connected to black-market Iranian oil proceeds.

articles.title: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral
articles.summary: The 114-page bill would change the tax treatment of crypto fees, stablecoins and lending while leaving existing reward-tax timing unchanged.

articles.title: Strive adds 469 Bitcoin to reach 25,000 BTC treasury
articles.summary: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase was funded entirely through its SATA preferred stock as the company continues its rapid climb among corporate BTC holders.

articles.title: SEC Grants Exemptive Relief from Certain Inline XBRL Filing or Submission Requirements
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission issued an order granting exemptive relief from certain Inline XBRL requirements adopted on Dec. 16, 2024. More specifically, the Commission is granting exemptive relief from filing or submitting the following in…

articles.title: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes address
articles.summary: An MEV bot known as “Yoink” front-ran an attacker attempting to exploit a custom Safe module, capturing the stolen rsETH before Kelp temporarily froze the receiving address.

articles.title: A hacker turned 25 cents of bitcoin into 46 billion fake BTC tokens on a DeFi bridge
articles.summary: Two software bugs allowed the attacker to create more than 2,000 times Bitcoin’s maximum supply in unbacked syBTC. Symbiosis puts preliminary losses at 9.97 BTC.

articles.title: Balancer eyes wind-down after restructuring fails to revive revenue
articles.summary: Balancer cut costs and shipped new products after restructuring, but Marcus Hardt says v3 failed to replace legacy revenue as November’s $128 million exploit continued to weigh on adoption.

articles.title: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
articles.summary: The 12-month test will put a beta version of the central bank currency through online, mobile, in-store and peer-to-peer payments.

articles.title: Standard Chartered predicts Arbitrum's ARB to rise 70-fold to $10, citing Robinhood Chain revenue
articles.summary: The bank expects tokenization to make Arbitrum a favored network for traditional finance, even though ARB holders currently have no direct claim on the fees.

articles.title: Why banks should stop worrying and learn to love the Clarity Act
articles.summary: They could be the biggest winners from regulatory clarity, argues Alex Tapscott, CEO of CMCC Global Capital Markets.

articles.title: Kraken brings DeFi yield to tokenized stocks and ETFs
articles.summary: Kraken’s new xStocks vaults let investors earn yield on tokenized versions of Nvidia and major US stock market ETFs by lending the assets in DeFi markets.

articles.title: Hong Kong crypto exchange CoinEx to cease operations after 9 years in business
articles.summary: Founder and CEO Haipo Yang cited mounting security and compliance risks and said he rejected a sale in favor of a “clean ending.”

articles.title: U.S. DOJ seeks $61 million in what it calls Iran's crypto-laundered black market oil sales
articles.summary: Prosecutors have filed a civil forfeiture complaint against what they call Iran's illegal crypto proceeds that are used to fund its military.

articles.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, narrowing the gap with Ethereum
articles.summary: Transaction V1 raises Solana’s limit to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, giving developers more room for multi-step trades, company-wallet approvals and privacy proofs.

articles.title: Solana lender Kamino taps Yieldstreet co-founder as CEO in Wall Street expansion
articles.summary: Michael Weisz will lead Kamino from a new New York headquarters as the DeFi lender is expanding into tokenized assets.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: USDT payments feature in Polish energy giant’s failed $230M oil deal: FT
articles.summary: Tether’s USDT stablecoin was part of a failed oil trade that reportedly cost a Polish energy giant $230 million in late 2023.

articles.title: Nigel Farage-backed Stack BTC plans to acquire a gold dealer for $16 million to fund bitcoin buy
articles.summary: The proposed acquisition would use cash flow from precious metals sales to build bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
articles.summary: Batch V1.1 would let users bundle up to eight linked transactions into one operation, with 27 of 35 trusted validators now backing the change.

articles.title: Bitcoin price falls to $75.6K September low as global bonds hit multidecade highs
articles.summary: Bitcoin price action weakened over market nerves prior to the Senate CLARITY Act vote, while surging bond yields pressured risk assets across the board.

articles.title: Standard Chartered says Arbitrum could outperform Bitcoin, Ether through 2030
articles.summary: Standard Chartered sees Robinhood Chain as an early sign that tokenization could transform Arbitrum’s economics and drive ARB sharply higher by 2030.

articles.title: Crypto Clarity Act barrels toward disappointment barring last-minute Senate turnaround
articles.summary: As the parties dig in their heels, the market structure bill hasn't yet amassed the votes it would need to clear the first Senate hurdle scheduled for Tuesday.

articles.title: Clarity Act's odds of passing plunge as Republicans reject Democrats' counter-proposal
articles.summary: Prediction markets sharply marked down the crypto market structure bill’s near-term prospects as negotiations remained stuck hours before a key Senate vote.

articles.title: To ensure permanent economic innovation, we must pass the Clarity Act now
articles.summary: Congress needs 60 Senators willing to put innovation first and provide critical relief to the digital asset industry, argues Rep. Shri Thanedar (D-Mich.)

articles.title: Ether, solana, XRP likely to gain if Clarity Act progresses
articles.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 15, 2026

articles.title: Velocity extends Series A to $48M at $200M valuation with backing from Visa, Circle, and Ripple
articles.summary: The investment brings Velocity's Series A round to $48 million and values the London-based payments infrastructure firm at $200 million, CEO Eric Queathem said.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives back Monday's gain as Clarity Act odds fade on Polymarket
articles.summary: Bitcoin fell 1.7% since midnight UTC to $76,862, unwinding a late Monday rally as Polymarket odds on the Clarity Act becoming law this year halved overnight.

articles.title: Ethereum, Base wallet standards talks fail, Ethlabs researcher says
articles.summary: Ethereum and Base are pursuing different account abstraction designs after talks failed, according to Ethlabs researcher Derek Chiang.

articles.title: Bitcoin short-term holders hit 30-day profit streak as bull-market odds improve: CryptoQuant
articles.summary: Bitcoin short-term holders approached a full month in partial profit as analysis saw improving odds of an enduring bullish BTC price reversal.

articles.title: CoinEx to cease operation after 9 years, citing ‘significant’ crypto contraction
articles.summary: CoinEx said falling trading volumes and liquidity, along with rising regulatory and compliance costs, had exceeded “reasonable boundaries,” with withdrawals remaining open until Dec. 22.

articles.title: Democrats send counteroffer to Republicans over Clarity Act provisions
articles.summary: Democratic Senators were said to be meeting late Monday to discuss the latest proposed draft text.

articles.title: U.S. House panel shares crypto tax bill ahead of hearing later this week
articles.summary: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking and other issues for which the industry's clamored for policies.

articles.title: Democrats push back on GOP’s ‘final’ CLARITY offer with counterproposal: Politico
articles.summary: Some Democrats remain dissatisfied with the bill’s crypto ethics provisions and will be sending a counterproposal just hours before a key procedural vote.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $79K, oil falls as Trump says Iran war could end
articles.summary: Bitcoin’s price rose toward $80,000 after US President Donald Trump hinted that the US-Iran war would end, pushing oil prices lower.

articles.title: CLARITY Act faces state AGs opposition ahead of key Senate vote
articles.summary: Trump’s ethics concession addresses one hurdle for the crypto bill, but 18 state attorneys general say the revised legislation would weaken state oversight.

revenue.note: Revenue is never estimated from engagement metrics. Only explicitly verified earnings fields are used.

creator_7_3.causal_claim_policy: Observational evidence is a hypothesis. Matched within-asset agreement reduces confounding but does not prove causality. Fresh controlled replication is required before stable promotion.

controller_policy.revenue_policy: Use revenue only when explicitly verified; never infer revenue from engagement.

current_experiment.hypothesis: Test whether experiment_format=data_driven_breakdown improves the outcome versus the account baseline while holding other major choices stable.
current_experiment.reason: Choose the next test where additional evidence can reduce uncertainty without sacrificing editorial quality.
stop_rules: Do not claim causality from observational evidence.
Skip weak stories rather than manufacture a test post.
Never use fake engagement or guaranteed-return language.

creator_7_5.next_action: Prefer a DISCOVERY opportunity that passes all existing gates. If unavailable, choose the strongest qualified opportunity rather than manufacturing a portfolio slot.
rules: Diversify across discovery, market intelligence, accountability, education, debate, macro and selective memes.
Never force a portfolio bucket when no verified high-quality story exists.
A major verified event can temporarily override the target mix.
Do not overfit to a single asset, topic, format or market regime.
Prefer substantive comments, shares, quotes and follower growth over raw views.
Use revenue only when explicitly verified; never infer revenue from engagement.
An active 7.4 experiment may shape the next post only when the natural story supports it.
Existing factual, originality, market-data, publication and anti-manipulation gates remain authoritative.

next_actions: Feed repeated attributable signals into Creator 7.4 experiment selection as hypotheses, not guarantees.
Feed stable portfolio-level patterns into Creator 7.5 only after repeated attributable evidence.
Preserve exact post/experiment attribution so future outcomes can explain why revenue occurred.
Keep unallocated verified revenue visible but excluded from attribution-based strategy learning.

experiment.use_policy: apply only when naturally supported by the selected story

next_cycle.instruction: Continue research/diversification. Waiting is correct when evidence or story quality is insufficient.

publisher_directive.experiment_instruction: Preserve the active experiment and apply it only when the naturally selected story supports the treatment.

creator_9_0.reason: No sufficiently strong publish directive is available at the strategy layer.

creator_pattern_hypotheses.hypothesis: Timely, useful content is more likely to earn attention than generic recaps.
Cashtags and chart widgets can connect readers to trading activity for Write to Earn attribution.
A concrete binary or multi-choice question lowers the effort required to reply.
Rotating formats reduces audience fatigue and creates more experiments.

editorial_principles.audience_value: Prefer stories that teach something, explain why a move matters, reveal an unusual development or create a substantive debate.
editorial_principles.breaking_news_override: A genuinely major verified breaking event may override topic cooldowns, but ordinary price movement may not.
editorial_principles.comment_quality: Prefer one specific evidence-based question with multiple defensible viewpoints over generic engagement bait.
editorial_principles.diversification: Compare opportunities across BTC, ETH, BNB, major altcoins, macro, regulation, liquidations, institutional activity and breaking news.
editorial_principles.evidence: Separate verified facts, observed market data, inference and unknowns. Never invent a causal explanation or statistic.
editorial_principles.human_editor_test: Before selecting a topic, ask whether an experienced crypto editor would spend one of the account's limited publishing opportunities on this story right now.
editorial_principles.learning: Treat individual post performance as noisy. Do not declare a winning topic from one post; use repeated observations before changing strategy.
editorial_principles.novelty: Do not repeat the same asset, event or angle merely because its raw market score remains high.
editorial_principles.publish_standard: Publish only when a story is genuinely useful, timely, evidence-backed and differentiated. Skipping is better than filler.
editorial_principles.visual_quality: Use a visual only when it adds truthful information. Market charts must use real supplied market data.

adaptive_experiment_controller.instruction: Use creator_7_4.current_experiment only when the naturally selected story supports it. Keep one primary variable stable. Never force weak stories, fake evidence, engagement, or returns.

autonomous_brain.instruction: Continue research/diversification. Waiting is correct when evidence or story quality is insufficient.

growth_portfolio.instruction: Prefer a DISCOVERY opportunity that passes all existing gates. If unavailable, choose the strongest qualified opportunity rather than manufacturing a portfolio slot.

strategy_memory.recommended_strategy: Run a two-loop editorial system: learn from our measured post outcomes and from public creator patterns. Use public patterns as hypotheses, never as copied templates. Prioritize replies and follower conversion over raw views. Keep testing different assets, hooks, formats, visuals and questions; retire repeated zero-conversion patterns.
